name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
AGENDA
Tuesday, October 16, 2018 - 06:30 p.m.
LOMITA CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBERS
24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA 90717
Published by the Office of the City Clerk
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation – Council Member Traina
d.
Roll Call
2.
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
3.
PRESENTATIONS
4.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a five minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2
prohibit the Council from taking action or engaging in discussion on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not on the agenda will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS AND MEETING ATTENDANCE REPORTS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL
6.
CITY MANAGER’S REPORT (information only)
7.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
ACTION: That the Consent Calendar Items 7 a-l, be approved.
a.
Motion to Waive Further Reading of resolutions and ordinances
b.
Approve the Minutes of the Regular meetings held on October 2, 2018
ACTION: That the minutes be approved.

ACTION: That the report be received and filed.
Item #7i
j.
ORD NO 799 – AN ORDINANCE OC THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF LOMITA, CALIFORNIA, REPEALING CHAPTER 13 (RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD) OF TITLE II OF THE LOMITA MUNICIPAL CODE, AMENDING CHAPTER 10 OF TITLE II (PARKS AND RECREATION COMMISSION) TO INCLUDE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES PREVIOUSLY ASSIGNED TO THE RAILROAD MUSEUM BOARD MEMBERS FROM THE DEFINITION OF CITY OFFICIAL IN CHAPTER 5 OF TITLE II (REVOLVING DOOR ORDINANCE) AND FINDING THE SAME CATEGORICALLY EXEMPT FROM THE CALIFORNIA ENVIRONMENTAL QUALITY ACT. (Second Reading)
ACTION: That the City Council adopt Ordinance No. 799.
Item #7j
k.
Accept Survey Monuments and Related Public Improvements for Tract Map No. 73720 (25054 Narbonne Avenue and 2154 250th Street)
ACTION: That the City Council accept the survey monuments and related public improvements constructed by the developer for Tract Map No. 73720 (25054 Narbonne Avenue and 2154 250th Street); and approve exoneration of all related bonds and securities related to the construction and setting of said survey monuments and related public improvements.
Item #7k
l.
Consideration and possible approval of a Professional Services Agreement with Harper & Burns, LLP to provide Administrative Hearing Officer Services
ACTION: Authorize the City Manager to execute a Professional Services Agreement (PSA) with Harper & Burns, LLP to provide Administrative Hearing Officer services to the City.
Item #7l
SCHEDULED ITEMS:
8.
PRESENTATION OF THE FINAL RETAIL ANALYSIS AND DOWNTOWN STRATEGY
Presented by Community & Economic Development Director Velasco
ACTION: To approve by minute order the final Retail Analysis and Downtown Strategy, as presented; and direct staff to begin implementation of the plan as outlined.
Item #8
9.
DISCUSSION AND POSSIBLE CANCELLATION AND/OR RESCHEDULING OF NOVEMBER 6, 2018, AND NOVEMBER 20, 2018, COUNCIL MEETINGS
10.
ADJOURNMENT That the City Council adjourn to the next regular meeting to be held on Tuesday, November 6, 2018, at 6:30 p.m. in the Council Chambers of City Hall, located at 24300 Narbonne Avenue, Lomita, CA.
I hereby certify under penalty of perjury under the laws of the State of California that the foregoing agenda was posted in the City Hall lobby and bulletin board, and posted on the City’s website not less than 72 hours prior to the meeting. A copy of said Agenda is on file in the Office of the City Clerk.
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
